.anticon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  color: inherit;
  font-style: normal;
  line-height: 0;
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: none;
  vertical-align: -0.125em;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

.anticon > * {
  line-height: 1;
}

.anticon svg {
  display: inline-block;
  vertical-align: inherit;
}

.anticon::before {
  display: none;
}

.anticon .anticon-icon {
  display: block;
}

.anticon[tabindex] {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.anticon-spin {
  -webkit-animation: loadingCircle 1s infinite linear;
  animation: loadingCircle 1s infinite linear;
}

@-webkit-keyframes loadingCircle {
  100% {
    -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

@keyframes loadingCircle {
  100% {
    -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

operating in Francophone West and Central Africa. It consolidates 40+ payment methods — including mobile money wallets (Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Flooz, T‑Money), major card networks (Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, AmEx, UnionPay) and regional e‑wallets — across 9+ countries, with native support for XOF/FCFA. <p>CinetPay is a payment aggregator platform serving Francophone West Africa, enabling merchants to accept payments through 40+ payment methods including mobile money wallets (Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Flooz, T-Money), bank cards (Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, American Express, Union Pay), and e-wallets across 9+ countries. Founded to solve fragmented payment infrastructure, CinetPay acts as a hub consolidating multiple payment channels into a single integration point.</p>
<h2 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="when-to-use-this-skill" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">When to Use This Skill<a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#when-to-use-this-skill" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading2 lucide-heading-2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M21 18h-4c0-4 4-3 4-6 0-1.5-2-2.5-4-1"></path></svg></span></a></h2>
<p>Use CinetPay for:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Mobile Money Payments</strong>: Accepting Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Flooz, T-Money across West Africa</li>
<li><strong>Multi-Country Expansion</strong>: Serving Côte d'Ivoire, Benin, Togo, Mali, Congo, Guinea, Niger, Senegal, Cameroon, Burkina Faso</li>
<li><strong>Unified Payment Interface</strong>: Single integration to support 40+ payment methods across regions</li>
<li><strong>E-commerce Platforms</strong>: Pre-built plugins for WooCommerce, PrestaShop, WHMCS, Moodle</li>
<li><strong>FCFA/XOF Transactions</strong>: Native support for West African CFA franc currency</li>
<li><strong>Merchant Settlements</strong>: Direct mobile money transfers to merchant accounts</li>
<li><strong>Subscription & Billing</strong>: Card-based recurring payments for SaaS/subscriptions</li>
</ul>
<p>Do <strong>not</strong> use CinetPay if:</p>
<ul>
<li>Your customers are in English-speaking Africa (Flutterwave or Paystack may be better)</li>
<li>You require payment support outside West/Central Africa</li>
<li>Your primary use case requires real-time payout verification (CinetPay has settlement delays)</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="webhook-requirements" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">Webhook Requirements<a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#webhook-requirements" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Must accept POST and GET</strong> requests</li>
<li><strong>Must be publicly accessible</strong> (https recommended)</li>
<li><strong>Must respond with 200 OK</strong> even if processing fails (so CinetPay stops retrying)</li>
<li><strong>Must call verification API</strong> — webhook data is for notification only, not for confirmation</li>
<li><strong>CinetPay may retry</strong> the notification multiple times; implement idempotency</li>
<li><strong>Security</strong>: Validate HMAC token in <code>X-TOKEN</code> header if present</li>

<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="pattern-3-woo-commerce-integration" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">Pattern 3: WooCommerce Integration<a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#pattern-3-woo-commerce-integration" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p><strong>Installation</strong>:</p>
<ol>
<li>Download CinetPay plugin from WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New</li>
<li>Search "CinetPay" and install</li>
<li>Activate plugin</li>
<li>Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments</li>
<li>Configure with your API key and Site ID</li>
<li>Enable and save</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Features</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Automatic order status updates on payment confirmation</li>
<li>Webhook auto-configuration</li>
<li>Support for all 40+ payment methods</li>
<li>Bilingual (FR/EN) payment interface</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Troubleshooting WooCommerce</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Verify notify_url is publicly accessible (WooCommerce generates this automatically)</li>
<li>Check <code>wp-config.php</code> allows outbound POST requests</li>
<li>Enable debug logging: <code>define('WP_DEBUG_LOG', true);</code></li>
</ul>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="pattern-4-presta-shop-integration" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">Pattern 4: PrestaShop Integration<a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#pattern-4-presta-shop-integration" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p><strong>Installation</strong>:</p>
<ol>
<li>Download from PrestaShop Addons or <code>Module Manager</code></li>
<li>Upload to <code>/modules/cinetpay/</code></li>
<li>Install via PrestaShop Admin</li>
<li>Configure payment method with API key and Site ID</li>
<li>Test in PrestaShop sandbox</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Features</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Automatic order creation and tracking</li>
<li>Multi-currency support (XOF, local currencies)</li>
<li>Customer account linking</li>
<li>Invoice generation on confirmation</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="important-notes-gotchas" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">Important Notes & Gotchas<a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#important-notes-gotchas" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading2 lucide-heading-2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M21 18h-4c0-4 4-3 4-6 0-1.5-2-2.5-4-1"></path></svg></span></a></h2>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="1-fcfa-currency-handling-is-critical" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">1. <strong>FCFA Currency Handling is Critical</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#1-fcfa-currency-handling-is-critical" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>CinetPay operates exclusively in <strong>West African CFA Franc (XOF)</strong> or local currencies. If your business operates in USD/EUR, you <strong>must convert at prevailing exchange rates before sending</strong>. CinetPay will not accept or convert currencies dynamically. Example: <code>amount = usd_price * 650</code> (approximate rate; use live rates in production).</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="2-transaction-i-ds-must-be-unique-globally" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">2. <strong>Transaction IDs Must Be Unique Globally</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#2-transaction-i-ds-must-be-unique-globally" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>Every payment request requires a unique <code>transaction_id</code>. Reusing transaction IDs will either be rejected or cause duplicate payments. Use format: <code>TXN-{timestamp}-{uuid}</code> or <code>TXN-{increment}-{date}</code>. Store transaction IDs in your database immediately after generating them.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="3-webhook-is-notification-only-not-confirmation" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">3. <strong>Webhook is Notification Only, Not Confirmation</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#3-webhook-is-notification-only-not-confirmation" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>CinetPay's webhook tells you payment status changed, <strong>but you must always call the verification API</strong> (<code>/v2/payment/check</code>) to confirm actual payment status. Man-in-the-middle attacks or network spoofing could fake webhook data. Never trust webhook data alone for fulfilling orders.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="4-customer-phone-number-format-is-strict" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">4. <strong>Customer Phone Number Format is Strict</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#4-customer-phone-number-format-is-strict" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>Phone numbers must include country code (e.g., <code>+225XXXXXXXXXX</code> for Côte d'Ivoire). Without the leading <code>+</code> and country code, mobile money payments may fail silently. Validate and normalize phone numbers before sending: <code>+{country_code}{number}</code>.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="5-language-parameter-affects-mobile-money-provider-display" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">5. <strong>Language Parameter Affects Mobile Money Provider Display</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#5-language-parameter-affects-mobile-money-provider-display" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>Setting <code>"lang": "FR"</code> shows payment interface in French and may prioritize French-language providers (Orange Money, Moov). Setting <code>"lang": "EN"</code> shows English and may prioritize English-supporting methods. For Francophone markets, use <code>"FR"</code> for better UX.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="6-settlement-delays-are-standard-24-48-hours" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">6. <strong>Settlement Delays Are Standard (24-48 Hours)</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#6-settlement-delays-are-standard-24-48-hours" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>CinetPay settles funds to your merchant account within 24-48 hours, not immediately. If a customer contacts support 1 hour after payment saying "I haven't received my item," you must still mark the order as pending until CinetPay confirms settlement. Track settlement status in your merchant dashboard separately from payment verification.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="7-country-codes-must-match-payment-method-available" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">7. <strong>Country Codes Must Match Payment Method Available</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#7-country-codes-must-match-payment-method-available" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>Not all payment methods are available in all countries. Example:</p>
<ul>
<li>Orange Money is available in: CI, SN, ML, GN</li>
<li>MTN MoMo is available in: CM, CI, BJ, TG, BF</li>
<li>Moov Money is available in: TG, BJ, CM, SN</li>
</ul>
<p>If you send <code>country: "SN"</code> with <code>channels: "ALL"</code>, only Senegal-available methods appear. Verify country code matches available methods or use <code>channels: "ALL"</code> and let CinetPay filter.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="8-return-url-redirect-is-not-reliable-for-payment-confirmation" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">8. <strong>Return URL Redirect is Not Reliable for Payment Confirmation</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#8-return-url-redirect-is-not-reliable-for-payment-confirmation" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>Customers may close the browser after payment before being redirected. <strong>Never rely on return_url callbacks to confirm payment</strong>. Only use <code>notify_url</code> (server-to-server webhook) and the verification API. The return_url is purely for user experience.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="9-rate-limiting-100-requests-per-minute-per-api-key" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">9. <strong>Rate Limiting: 100 Requests Per Minute Per API Key</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#9-rate-limiting-100-requests-per-minute-per-api-key" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>CinetPay applies rate limits. If you exceed ~100 requests/minute, subsequent requests will be throttled. Batch verification requests and implement exponential backoff. Cache verification results when possible.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="10-metadata-and-custom-fields-are-silently-truncated" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">10. <strong>Metadata and Custom Fields Are Silently Truncated</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#10-metadata-and-custom-fields-are-silently-truncated" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>Fields like <code>invoice_data</code>, <code>metadata</code>, and <code>description</code> have length limits (typically 255 chars). Longer values are silently truncated without error. Always validate field lengths before sending or risk losing important information.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="11-service-id-site-id-must-match-service-type" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">11. <strong>Service ID (site_id) Must Match Service Type</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#11-service-id-site-id-must-match-service-type" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>Each <code>site_id</code> is tied to a specific service (e.g., "Payments", "Transfers", "Subscriptions"). You cannot use a <code>site_id</code> from the "Transfers" service for payment processing. Verify your <code>site_id</code> matches your integration use case in the merchant dashboard.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="12-seamless-integration-vs-checkout-differs-significantly" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">12. <strong>Seamless Integration vs. Checkout Differs Significantly</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#12-seamless-integration-vs-checkout-differs-significantly" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>CinetPay offers two integration modes:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Standard (Checkout)</strong>: Redirect to CinetPay-hosted page (this guide)</li>
<li><strong>Seamless (SDK)</strong>: Embedded payment form in your site (requires JavaScript SDK)</li>
</ul>
<p>Seamless is faster but requires frontend SDK. Checkout is easier but requires redirect. Choose based on UX requirements, not interchangeably.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="13-test-vs-production-environment" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">13. <strong>Test vs. Production Environment</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#13-test-vs-production-environment" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>Same API key works for <strong>both test and production</strong>. To test:</p>
<ol>
<li>Use test credentials (API key + site_id configured for test)</li>
<li>Test notifications by simulating webhook calls</li>
<li>Verify with test transactions before going live</li>
<li>Production uses same endpoints; no URL changes needed</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="14-hmac-token-verification-implementation-may-vary" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">14. <strong>HMAC Token Verification Implementation May Vary</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#14-hmac-token-verification-implementation-may-vary" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>CinetPay includes an <code>X-TOKEN</code> header in webhook requests for HMAC verification. However, HMAC implementation details vary by documentation version. Always verify transactions directly with the API regardless of token validity.</p>
<h3 class="acss-7f8e2k" id="15-payment-methods-depend-on-customer-s-mobile-operator" style="color: var(--ant-color-text);">15. <strong>Payment Methods Depend on Customer's Mobile Operator</strong><a aria-label="Permalink for this section" class="title-anchor acss-156hytl" href="#15-payment-methods-depend-on-customer-s-mobile-operator" style="scroll-margin-top: 96px;"><span class="anticon" role="img"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="transparent" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-heading3 lucide-heading-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h8"></path><path d="M4 18V6"></path><path d="M12 18V6"></path><path d="M17.5 10.5c1.7-1 3.5 0 3.5 1.5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2"></path><path d="M17 17.5c2 1.5 4 .3 4-1.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2"></path></svg></span></a></h3>
<p>Even if <code>channels: "MOBILE"</code> is set, customer's actual payment method options depend on their SIM card operator. A customer with Vodafone (no partnership) might not see any mobile money option despite requesting mobile channel. Design your UX to handle empty payment method lists gracefully.</p>

|\n| `201` | CREATED | Transaction created (pending) | Wait for webhook notification |\n| `600` | PAYMENT_FAILED | Payment processing failed | Verify customer has sufficient balance; retry |\n| `602` | INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE | Customer balance too low | Customer must top up wallet |\n| `608` | MINIMUM_REQUIRED_FIELDS | Missing required parameter | Check all mandatory fields in request |\n| `609` | AUTH_NOT_FOUND | Invalid API key | Verify API key from merchant panel |\n| `613` | ERROR_SITE_ID_NOTVALID | Invalid site_id | Verify site_id from merchant panel |\n| `627` | TRANSACTION_CANCEL | User cancelled payment | Inform customer; allow retry |\n| `701` | INVALID_CREDENTIALS | Login credentials wrong | Check API key and site_id |\n| `706` | INVALID_TOKEN | Payment token invalid/expired | Reinitialize payment |\n| `723` | NOT_FOUND | Transaction not found | Verify transaction_id is correct |\n\n### Error Handling Best Practices\n\n```python\ndef safe_api_call(endpoint, payload, max_retries=3):\n    \"\"\"Safely call CinetPay API with retry logic\"\"\"\n\n    import time\n\n    for attempt in range(max_retries):\n        try:\n            response = requests.post(\n                endpoint,\n                json=payload,\n                headers={\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"},\n                timeout=10\n            )\n            response.raise_for_status()\n\n            result = response.json()\n\n            # Check CinetPay error code\n            if result.get(\"code\") == \"00\":\n                return {\"success\": True, \"data\": result}\n\n            # Retryable errors\n            elif result.get(\"code\") in [\"201\", \"627\"]:\n                if attempt \u003c max_retries - 1:\n                    time.sleep(2 ** attempt)  # Exponential backoff\n                    continue\n                return {\"success\": False, \"retryable\": True, \"error\": result}\n\n            # Non-retryable errors\n            else:\n                return {\"success\": False, \"retryable\": False, \"error\": result}\n\n        except requests.exceptions.Timeout:\n            if attempt \u003c max_retries - 1:\n                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)\n                continue\n            return {\"success\": False, \"retryable\": True, \"error\": \"Timeout after retries\"}\n\n        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:\n            return {\"success\": False, \"retryable\": False, \"error\": str(e)}\n\n    return {\"success\": False, \"retryable\": False, \"error\": \"Max retries exceeded\"}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Important Notes \u0026 Gotchas\n\n### 1. **FCFA Currency Handling is Critical**\nCinetPay operates exclusively in **West African CFA Franc (XOF)** or local currencies. If your business operates in USD/EUR, you **must convert at prevailing exchange rates before sending**. CinetPay will not accept or convert currencies dynamically. Example: `amount = usd_price * 650` (approximate rate; use live rates in production).\n\n### 2. **Transaction IDs Must Be Unique Globally**\nEvery payment request requires a unique `transaction_id`. Reusing transaction IDs will either be rejected or cause duplicate payments. Use format: `TXN-{timestamp}-{uuid}` or `TXN-{increment}-{date}`. Store transaction IDs in your database immediately after generating them.\n\n### 3. **Webhook is Notification Only, Not Confirmation**\nCinetPay's webhook tells you payment status changed, **but you must always call the verification API** (`/v2/payment/check`) to confirm actual payment status. Man-in-the-middle attacks or network spoofing could fake webhook data. Never trust webhook data alone for fulfilling orders.\n\n### 4. **Customer Phone Number Format is Strict**\nPhone numbers must include country code (e.g., `+225XXXXXXXXXX` for Côte d'Ivoire). Without the leading `+` and country code, mobile money payments may fail silently. Validate and normalize phone numbers before sending: `+{country_code}{number}`.\n\n### 5. **Language Parameter Affects Mobile Money Provider Display**\nSetting `\"lang\": \"FR\"` shows payment interface in French and may prioritize French-language providers (Orange Money, Moov). Setting `\"lang\": \"EN\"` shows English and may prioritize English-supporting methods. For Francophone markets, use `\"FR\"` for better UX.\n\n### 6. **Settlement Delays Are Standard (24-48 Hours)**\nCinetPay settles funds to your merchant account within 24-48 hours, not immediately. If a customer contacts support 1 hour after payment saying \"I haven't received my item,\" you must still mark the order as pending until CinetPay confirms settlement. Track settlement status in your merchant dashboard separately from payment verification.\n\n### 7. **Country Codes Must Match Payment Method Available**\nNot all payment methods are available in all countries. Example:\n- Orange Money is available in: CI, SN, ML, GN\n- MTN MoMo is available in: CM, CI, BJ, TG, BF\n- Moov Money is available in: TG, BJ, CM, SN\n\nIf you send `country: \"SN\"` with `channels: \"ALL\"`, only Senegal-available methods appear. Verify country code matches available methods or use `channels: \"ALL\"` and let CinetPay filter.\n\n### 8. **Return URL Redirect is Not Reliable for Payment Confirmation**\nCustomers may close the browser after payment before being redirected. **Never rely on return_url callbacks to confirm payment**. Only use `notify_url` (server-to-server webhook) and the verification API. The return_url is purely for user experience.\n\n### 9. **Rate Limiting: 100 Requests Per Minute Per API Key**\nCinetPay applies rate limits. If you exceed ~100 requests/minute, subsequent requests will be throttled. Batch verification requests and implement exponential backoff. Cache verification results when possible.\n\n### 10. **Metadata and Custom Fields Are Silently Truncated**\nFields like `invoice_data`, `metadata`, and `description` have length limits (typically 255 chars). Longer values are silently truncated without error. Always validate field lengths before sending or risk losing important information.\n\n### 11. **Service ID (site_id) Must Match Service Type**\nEach `site_id` is tied to a specific service (e.g., \"Payments\", \"Transfers\", \"Subscriptions\"). You cannot use a `site_id` from the \"Transfers\" service for payment processing. Verify your `site_id` matches your integration use case in the merchant dashboard.\n\n### 12. **Seamless Integration vs. Checkout Differs Significantly**\nCinetPay offers two integration modes:\n- **Standard (Checkout)**: Redirect to CinetPay-hosted page (this guide)\n- **Seamless (SDK)**: Embedded payment form in your site (requires JavaScript SDK)\n\nSeamless is faster but requires frontend SDK. Checkout is easier but requires redirect. Choose based on UX requirements, not interchangeably.\n\n### 13. **Test vs. Production Environment**\nSame API key works for **both test and production**. To test:\n1. Use test credentials (API key + site_id configured for test)\n2. Test notifications by simulating webhook calls\n3. Verify with test transactions before going live\n4. Production uses same endpoints; no URL changes needed\n\n### 14. **HMAC Token Verification Implementation May Vary**\nCinetPay includes an `X-TOKEN` header in webhook requests for HMAC verification. However, HMAC implementation details vary by documentation version. Always verify transactions directly with the API regardless of token validity.\n\n### 15. **Payment Methods Depend on Customer's Mobile Operator**\nEven if `channels: \"MOBILE\"` is set, customer's actual payment method options depend on their SIM card operator.
